svg.text: Pipeline optimization — same work, less waiting
MODULE 14 PIPELINE — every push runs everything, in sequence
Total about 14 minutes. A README change costs the same as a code change.
Three pushes in five minutes means three full pipelines racing each other to the cluster.
only the services that actually changed continue
Total about 3 minutes for a code change. Zero for a docs change.
A new push cancels the one still running, so only the newest commit reaches the cluster.
Production waits for a named human to approve it.
skip services that did not change
dependencies and docker layers survive between runs
independent jobs do not wait for each other
cancel superseded runs instead of racing them
approval and separate credentials per stage
